# jumpcloud_application (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud SSO application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SAML application
resource "jumpcloud_application" "finance" {
  name          = "finance-portal"
  display_label = "Finance Portal"
  sso_url       = "https://finance.example.com/sso"

  logo = {
    url = "https://finance.example.com/logo.png"
  }

  sso = {
    type         = "saml"
    sp_entity_id = "https://finance.example.com/saml/metadata"
    acs_url      = "https://finance.example.com/saml/acs"
  }
}

# OIDC application with SCIM provisioning
resource "jumpcloud_application" "wiki" {
  name          = "wiki"
  display_label = "Company Wiki"

  sso = {
    type          = "oidc"
    redirect_uris = ["https://wiki.example.com/oauth/callback"]
  }

  provision = {
    enabled  = true
    type     = "scim"
    base_url = "https://wiki.example.com/scim/v2"
    token    = var.wiki_scim_token
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the application.

### Optional

- `display_label` (String) Display label shown in the user portal.
- `logo` (Attributes) Application logo configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logo))
- `provision` (Attributes) Provisioning/SCIM settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provision))
- `sso` (Attributes) SSO settings (SAML/OIDC configuration). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sso))
- `sso_url` (String) SSO URL for the application.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the application.

<a id="nestedatt--logo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logo`

Optional:

- `url` (String) URL of the logo image.


<a id="nestedatt--provision"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provision`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether provisioning is enabled.

Optional:

- `base_url` (String) SCIM base URL.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) SCIM bearer token.
- `type` (String) Provisioning type (e.g. scim).


<a id="nestedatt--sso"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sso`

Required:

- `type` (String) SSO type: saml or oidc.

Optional:

- `acs_url` (String) Assertion consumer service URL (SAML).
- `client_id` (String) Client ID (OIDC, computed).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret (OIDC, computed).
- `idp_cert` (String, Sensitive) Identity provider certificate (SAML, computed).
- `idp_entity_id` (String) Identity provider entity ID (SAML, computed).
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Redirect URIs (OIDC).
- `sp_entity_id` (String) Service provider entity ID (SAML).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_application.example <application-id>
```
